text:
Claire: quick design pass  playground streaming UI — compact fallback + token visibility.
Claire: users keep thinking small streamed fragments mean the model is frozen. proposal: when stream throughput drops, collapse trailing fragments into a single "streaming paused" chip with a token count and an affordance to either resume or regenerate.
Ibrahim: agree. also important: voiceover should not read every tiny fragment. set live region to polite for chunks and announce once when we collapse: 'Streaming paused, 12 tokens buffered.'
Nia: for desktop controls i like a subtle right-side micro-toolbar for long outputs (Replay | Stop | Copy). mobile: reveal same actions from long-press sheet. that keeps chrome minimal.
Theo: small implementation note: runtime exposes meta.buffered_token_count and meta.can_resume. show "Resume" if can_resume true, otherwise show "Regenerate". also include keyboard hint: "Regenerate (Ctrl/Cmd+Enter)".
Claire: microcopy: options for the chip text: "Streaming paused 5 tokens buffered", "Output paused 5 tokens queued", "Partial output (15 tokens)". which reads best?
Ibrahim: "Streaming paused 5 tokens buffered" is clear and signals resumability. for aria-label: "Streaming paused, 15 tokens buffered. Actions: resume, stop, copy."
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: chip must be focusable (tabindex=0), announce on state change only, tooltips accessible on focus, and include visible focus outline (2px). prefer aria-live=polite on the chunk region and role=status for the collapsed announcement.
Nia: token visibility: show a faint inline tag like "22 tks" near timestamp; hover/focus reveals tooltip "Token usage for this response". add a per-user pin toggle to keep token tags visible in convo.
Theo: telemetry: add events playground.stream_paused, playground.resume_click, playground.regenerate_click. payload: { buffered_tokens, can_resume, trigger }. keep payload small.
Claire: A/B test idea: toolbar vs inline micro-actions and "Resume" vs "Regenerate" wording. instrument confusion metric (help clicks / quick cancels).
Ibrahim: dev spike: i'll prototype the toolbar and accessible announcer. will push branch `playground/stream-fallback-chip` and share preview.
Nia: small a11y nit: tooltips must appear on keyboard focus not only hover. also ensure the chip doesn't steal focus when it appears.
Claire: timeline: Ibrahim spike by EOD, Nia will write aria spec, Theo will add telemetry draft. will reconvene after preview. :rocket:
